sunleaf.name: Translucent fresh green
sunleaf.role: Transmitted-light leaves and bright grass surfaces

sun.name: Bright yellow emphasis
sun.role: Character clothing and sparse focal accents

accent_exception.usage: Actual species features, flowers or this shot's explicit legend; do not replace large areas of the main colors without a reason

lines.outline_policy: Natural objects defined mainly by color/brush edges, not uniform black borders

spacing.adaptation_note: Existing bright-series working values retain caption radius20/label14 and padding20/28; source16/12 and padding16 remain reference starting values, not automatic replacements.

scope: Historical approved 2D appearance and requested illustration covers only. Realistic main footage uses its own applicable reference; these tokens do not prohibit Blender or impose illustration colors on scientific objects. New video labels, leaders and arrows use precision-annotations.tokens.json; legacy portrait label size, round label plates and arrow settings do not override that profile. Caption and cover settings retain their own scope.
color_space: sRGB preview; video color conversion not performed
palette_method: Visual role-based working palette; not a pixel-extraction claim.

suggested_scene_ratio.definition: Visual-area starting point for daytime natural scenes, not pixel statistics of the reference image; adjust each scene to its objects and facts

not_validated: new full scene or character variants

material.meaning: Shape materials according to actual object properties and explanatory conditions; fabric, transparent bodies, rock/soil and other materials do not share one matte/highlight preset.

motion.meaning: Interface/observation starting points only; physical actions use mechanism-specific trajectories
